name: CFPS Inhibitor Dose (Part 3a)
description: Part 3a of the TEM-1 inhibitor screen: doses up to 4 already-expressed TEM1 concentration groups (built by cfps_mastermix / Part 1, confirmed by cfps_sfgfp_confirmation / Part 2) from a pre-arrayed compound_library plate holding one working-stock well per concentration. The plate map is one compound per run, 4 concentrations x 2 duplicate wells (see cfps_inhibitor_dose_response's row layout, e.g. exp2_100ul_report.md's Plate/well layout section) — each group shares a single tip and a single source well across its duplicate pair: one attach, one aspirate of the combined (2x) volume, two equal dispenses, one eject. No nitrocefin here and no mixing step — mixing-in-place was dropped project-wide (the tip retracts fully at the end of every epipette_dispense, so a separate mix-in-place node never actually had liquid to work with). After this run, let the compound incubate with the enzyme off-robot, then add nitrocefin by hand, then run cfps_inhibitor_kinetic_read (Part 3b) to load the plate into the reader.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: run started
nodes.description: Registers this execution in data/logs/ before any hardware moves, so a run that fails early is still visible to the tracker instead of leaving nothing behind. Its outgoing edge is deliberately 'default', not 'on_success': a checkpoint is bookkeeping, and a failure to record progress must never abort a run that is physically fine. The validator flags this as unconditional — that is the intent.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: pipetting done
nodes.description: Refreshes the run folder once all pipetting is complete, before labware handling — so a failure during plate/reader moves still has every dispensed leg on record. Its outgoing edge is deliberately 'default', not 'on_success': a checkpoint is bookkeeping, and a failure to record progress must never abort a run that is physically fine. The validator flags this as unconditional — that is the intent.
